dialogues.text_zh: 還在演啊？本魔王早就知道愛情魔法對妳沒用了。就像回收魔力一樣，那本來就是妳體內的東西，怎麼可能對妳有用？

dialogues.speaker: Cupid
dialogues.text: Ugh...! If you already knew, why didn't you just say so earlier? Are you just playing me for a fool?
dialogues.text_zh: 唔……！既然早就知道了，幹嘛不早點說啦，把我當笨蛋耍喔……

dialogues.speaker: Master
dialogues.text: No, it's just that I really enjoy this kind of roleplay. And from the way you look, you're enjoying it too, aren't you?
dialogues.text_zh: 不是，是因為本魔王很享受這種情境劇。看妳也挺享受的樣子，我沒說錯吧？

dialogues.speaker: Cupid
dialogues.text: Mmm... This slow, delicious descent... is really thrilling...♥
dialogues.text_zh: 嗯嗯……這種慢慢墮落的感覺，確實很讓人興奮……♥

dialogues.speaker: Master
dialogues.text: Right? Then this time, let me have a taste of it. Come on! Seduce me with your wicked body. Let's turn Emerald City into our city of love!
dialogues.text_zh: 對吧？那這次換本魔王體驗了。#來吧！用妳那淫蕩的肉體，征服本魔王，把翡翠城變成我們的愛之城！

dialogues.speaker: Cupid
dialogues.text: Eh—wait, what? This is the script now?!
dialogues.text_zh: 咦、咦咦咦——是這劇本！？

role_voices.text_zh: 愛神邱比特，就是我！我才不是站在噴水池中央小便的小嬰兒呢！
role_voices.text_en: I am Cupid, the goddess of love! And for the record, that peeing baby statue looks nothing like me!

role_voices.text_zh: 愛是很美好的事物喲！可是這個世界實在太缺愛了……所以我要把愛，散播到全世界——！
role_voices.text_en: Love is a wonderful thing! But there's just not enough love in this world... So I'm going to spread love everywhere—!

role_voices.text_zh: 看我的……愛之箭！呀啊啊！不小心射錯人了！給趕緊回收魔力才行！
role_voices.text_en: Take this… Love Arrow! Hyah! Whoops, wrong target! I better retract the magic, fast!

role_voices.text_zh: 阿芙羅狄忒大人的戀愛觀其實跟我差滿多的。她的戀愛觀，唔……不予置評！
role_voices.text_en: Lady Aphrodite's views on love are actually quite different from mine. Her perspectives are... well, no comment!

role_voices.text_zh: 凡妮娜好厲害喲，她可以一次變出十顆香草冰淇淋球！她的香草冰淇淋也超好吃的～
role_voices.text_en: Fannina is awesome—she can make ten scoops of vanilla ice cream appear at once! And her vanilla ice cream is super tasty too~

role_voices.text_zh: 昨天潘朵拉問我「愛」是什麼……好難說明喔。「愛就是我的箭！」我也只能這樣回答了！
role_voices.text_en: Yesterday, Pandora asked me, "What is love?"... It's really hard to explain. "Love is my arrow!" That's all I could say in response!

role_voices.text_zh: 呃，照著唸就好了嗎？那——咳嗯！以愛、勇氣，與希望之名，性愛之神——吼，是愛神啦！
role_voices.text_en: Uh, I just need to follow the script? Okay—ahem! In the name of love, courage, and hope—Goddess of Sex—wait, I mean, Goddess of Love!

role_voices.text_zh: 哈哈哈……！臣服於我的腳下吧！魔王！翡翠城，馬上就要成為我們的愛之城啦♥
role_voices.text_en: Hahaha…! Bow before me, Archfiend! The Emerald City is about to become our city of love! ♥

role_voices.text_zh: 啊嗯、啊嗯，好舒服喔……用過這根肉棒的女生，應該都會變得很專情吧……♥
role_voices.text_en: Mmm, ahh, it feels so good... Any girl who's experienced this cock would probably become completely devoted...♥
May all lovers find their happy ending~

role_voices.text_zh: 啊啊……這就是，青春的味道！
role_voices.text_en: Aah... so this is the taste of youth!

role_voices.text_zh: 即便我不在了……愛……也不會…消失……
role_voices.text_en: Even if I'm gone... love... will not... disappear...

role_voices.text_zh: 耶！這場勝利，獻給我們永恆的愛！
role_voices.text_en: Yay! This victory is dedicated to our eternal love!
